correctness.rationale: The exact published permutation generators and facet orbits reconstruct a closed 12-vertex surface with f=(12,42,28). Unimodular integer reduction of the 28 face relations in a rank-31 graph-cycle lattice gives Smith data 1^27,2, hence H_1 is Z^3 plus Z/2. Three integral cocycles and one mod-two cocycle are checked on every relation and are jointly onto the proved quotient using explicit free-basis cycles and an explicit torsion witness. Exhaustion of all 48 graph triangles proves that all 20 nonfaces are nonzero, have primitive free projection, occupy exactly four free directions, and realize both torsion lifts with counts 4 and 1. The A4 carrier and class orbits are exhaustively recomputed.

value.rationale: This surface is a natural highly symmetric nonorientable genus-four triangulation whose first homology mixes rank-three free part with order-two torsion. The complete first possible simple-cycle layer is therefore a motivated combinatorial systolic invariant. The result shows that every empty triangle is essential and primitive after free projection, and resolves how the torsion extension appears at minimum length: four free directions, both torsion lifts in every direction, and a uniform 4+1 multiplicity organized into two A4 class orbits. These facts are not determined by the face vector, abstract H_1 group, or vertex transitivity.
